fields.title: Additional feasible P3 witnesses
fields.finding: The published priced witnesses reproduce, but a separate multistart search finds better points. Walls 1.5/2.0/3.0 mm yield SF 0.805476/0.483053/0.223304 versus 0.800189/0.469060/null. At 303.532 MPa film allowable, SF 0.975445 uses 848.604 kg film, versus 0.975205 and 880.534 kg.
fields.proposed_fix: Retain filed points as local witnesses, add the independently verified alternatives and distinguish an unsuccessful search from an infeasibility proof. None of these wall/tear cases reaches SF 1.
